summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, postponing its extraordinary general meeting for the third time, now to October 8, 2026. The meeting seeks approval of an Extension Amendment to allow up to six monthly extensions of the initial business combination deadline from October 9, 2026 to April 9, 2027. The redemption deadline was extended to October 7, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. The filing is a routine procedural update; watch for shareholder approval and redemption levels, which signal deal risk and overhang.
